independent_pi.operator_assistance: Runtime/context/tool access repairs plus factual native collision and service failure reviews. Pi alone authors its design files; no reference CAD answer supplied. Not an unassisted trial.
remaining_limits: The independent product has not received native PCB, firmware, physical fit or hardware validation.
Thin-film support, fastening, cable routing and component envelopes remain preliminary.
Daily energy uses unmeasured 1uA leakage; normal trajectory completes 139 of 240 requested events.

native_eda.routing: Manual source-bound FreeRouting/SES/native width correction pipeline succeeded. Generic adapter unit tests and refusal of existing copper passed; generic adapter full successful route not yet replayed.
native_eda.later_connection: eng-d2ab23795c8b075b returned UNKNOWN after native window disconnected; no automatic retry or new DRC claim.

boundaries: No manufactured sample, MCU flashing, physical assembly or measurements.
Reference: normal 107/120 and no cold-start service within 48h. Independent: normal 139/240, cold first ready about25.94h, assuming unmeasured1uA leakage. Neither promises hardware or every event.
Mechanical tolerances, fasteners, cable routing and electrical switching quality require further review.
COMSOL is available as a separate cantilever adapter; no whole-product FEM result claimed.
Existing root scientific features, feat-397 and B2 gates unchanged.
next: Engineering review and measured prototype of the reference product.
Independently bind PCB and firmware if advancing the Pi design beyond its digital-assembly scope.
Keep future Harness RSI efficacy evaluation separate from this assisted acceptance.

final_package.scope: Sealed reference v5 plus independent v12/v13/v14 and audit evidence
